contexts.text: Roasted with fire () = the good which is of love; for things roasted with fire = the good of love, because fire = love, and roasted, that which is imbued with love, consequently, good. A distinction is made in the Word between what is roasted, and what is boiled; and by what is roasted is signified good, because by fire...
Thus the broiled fish (). (See Fish, at AE 513:19. AE 619:15.)
As roasted with fire = the good of celestial and spiritual love, in the opposite, it = the evil which is of the love of self and of the world. Illustrated.
To roast roast, and to roast flesh () = to operate evil from filthy love.
